readingText.title: Rana's Update
readingText.text: Hi Ahmed! Here is my news. I normally work in a small library in Basra, and I walk there every morning because it is close to my flat. But this month my situation is a little different. The library is closed for repairs, so I am working from home and answering emails all day. I miss the quiet rooms, but I like the extra sleep. It is only a temporary change, and we open again in May.
readingText.textAr: أهلاً أحمد! إليكَ أخباري. أعمل عادةً في مكتبة صغيرة في البصرة، وأمشي إليها كل صباح لأنها قريبة من شقتي. لكن وضعي هذا الشهر مختلف قليلاً: المكتبة مغلقة للترميم، فصرتُ أعمل من البيت وأردّ على الرسائل طوال النهار. تنقصني القاعات الهادئة، لكن ساعة النوم الإضافية تعجبني. إنه تغيير مؤقت فقط، وسنفتح أبوابنا من جديد في أيار.

activities.audioTranscript: Hello, it's Basim. I usually drive the school bus in the mornings, and I am free every afternoon. This month I am also taking my mother to the hospital twice a week, because she cannot drive after her operation. I am tired, but she is getting better.

activities.prompt: Before you write anything, say your update aloud, the way Rana wrote hers. Give one thing you usually do, one thing that is different right now, and the reason.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب شيئاً، قل تحديثك بصوت عالٍ كما كتبت رنا تحديثها. اذكر شيئاً تفعله عادةً، وشيئاً مختلفاً في الوقت الحالي، والسبب.

activities.prompt: Suhad sent you this message, and your friend Dina never saw it. Tell Dina what Suhad usually does, what is new this term and why, and how Dina can join.
activities.promptAr: أرسلت لكَ سُهاد هذه الرسالة، ولم ترَها صديقتكَ دينا. أخبر دينا بما تفعله سُهاد عادةً، وما الجديد هذا الفصل ولماذا، وكيف تستطيع دينا الانضمام.
activities.sourceCard: Message from Suhad: I still teach Arabic at the centre on Mondays and Wednesdays. This term I am also giving a free online class on Saturday mornings, because many of my old students have moved abroad. Anyone can join; just send me your email.

activities.prompt: Now write your own life update to an old classmate. Say what you usually do, what is different at the moment, and why. Join your ideas with and, but and because.
activities.promptAr: اكتب الآن تحديثاً عن حياتك إلى زميل دراسة قديم. اذكر ما تفعله عادةً، وما المختلف في الوقت الحالي، والسبب. اربط أفكارك بـ and وbut وbecause.

lessons.title: Mission: A Two-Minute Life Update
lessons.titleAr: المهمة: تحديث عن الحياة في دقيقتين
lessons.scenario: You meet a former classmate online. Exchange updates, ask follow-up questions and relay one useful detail to another friend.

activities.prompt: Read your old classmate's profile. Why does Maha start work earlier at the moment?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الملف الشخصي لزميلتك القديمة. لماذا تبدأ مها عملها مبكراً في الوقت الحالي؟
options: She is taking an evening course
She has a new job at a hotel
The agency opens at seven now
activities.answer: She is taking an evening course
activities.sourceText: Maha Saleh, Baghdad. We were in the same class at school! I work at a travel agency near the river, and I normally start at nine. At the moment I start at seven and finish at three, because I am taking an evening course in hotel management.

activities.prompt: Listen to Maha's voice message. What does she say about the course?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة مها الصوتية. ماذا تقول عن الدورة؟
options: It is going well, but it makes her tired
It is too difficult, so she wants to stop
It is easy, and she has plenty of free time
activities.answer: It is going well, but it makes her tired
activities.audioTranscript: Hi again, it's Maha. The course is going really well. We have classes on Monday and Thursday evenings, and each one lasts two hours. I am always tired on Friday, but the teacher is excellent and I am learning a lot. Anyway, tell me about your week.

activities.prompt: You are talking to Maha online. Reply to her news, say what your week is like at the moment, and ask her at least two follow-up questions.
activities.promptAr: أنتَ تتحدث إلى مها عبر الإنترنت. ردّ على خبرها، وقل كيف يبدو أسبوعك في الوقت الحالي، واسألها سؤالَي متابعة على الأقل.
partnerTurns: I can't believe it's you! I'm still in Baghdad. How are things with you these days?
Me? I'm fine, but busy. I'm staying with my brother's family this year, because my flat is too far from the agency.
It's only until the summer. Now tell me about your week, and ask me whatever you want to know.

activities.prompt: Give Maha your own update, one to two minutes long. Say what you usually do, one thing that is different at the moment, why it is different, and how you feel about it.
activities.promptAr: قدّم لمها تحديثك أنتَ، في دقيقة إلى دقيقتين. اذكر ما تفعله عادةً، وشيئاً واحداً مختلفاً في الوقت الحالي، وسبب اختلافه، وكيف تشعر حياله.

activities.prompt: Maha sent you this message, and your friend Firas works at a hotel. Tell him what the trip is, who can go, what is included, and what he must do before Friday.
activities.promptAr: أرسلت لكَ مها هذه الرسالة، وصديقكَ فراس يعمل في فندق. أخبره ما هي الرحلة، ومن يستطيع الذهاب، وما الذي تشمله، وما عليه فعله قبل الجمعة.
activities.sourceCard: Message from Maha: My agency has two free places on a weekend English trip to Babylon in April. It is for people who work in tourism. The bus and the room are included, but not the food. Send me a name before Friday and I can add it to the list.

activities.prompt: Write your message back to Maha. Say what you usually do and what is different at the moment, give the reason, and ask her two questions about her course. Join your ideas with and, but and because.
activities.promptAr: اكتب رسالتك الجوابية إلى مها. اذكر ما تفعله عادةً وما المختلف في الوقت الحالي، وبيّن السبب، واسألها سؤالين عن دورتها. اربط أفكارك بـ and وbut وbecause.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.en: Last weekend, I was in Najaf with my cousins. The streets were busy, but the visit was memorable.
dialogue.ar: في عطلة الأسبوع الماضية كنت في النجف مع أبناء عمومتي. كانت الشوارع مزدحمة، لكن الزيارة لا تُنسى.

activities.prompt: Where was the speaker?
activities.audioTranscript: Last weekend, I was in Najaf with my cousins. The streets were busy, but the visit was memorable.

activities.prompt: Match the key language to its Arabic meaning.
Complete the sentence.
activities.text: The cafés ___ busy last night.

activities.prompt: Who was at the party?
activities.audioTranscript: Rita was at a family party yesterday. Her parents were there too.

activities.prompt: Say where you were yesterday and how it was.
activities.promptAr: قل أين كنت أمس وكيف كان الأمر.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.en: We arrived early, visited the castle and decided to eat near the river.
dialogue.ar: وصلنا مبكراً وزرنا القلعة وقررنا أن نأكل قرب النهر.

activities.prompt: Where did they eat?
activities.audioTranscript: We arrived early, visited the castle and decided to eat near the river.

activities.prompt: Match the key language to its Arabic meaning.
Complete the sentence.
activities.text: Maya ___ her aunt on Monday.

activities.prompt: What happened at noon?
activities.audioTranscript: Ali planned a picnic, packed lunch and walked to the park. Rain started at noon.

activities.prompt: Describe three regular past actions from a recent day.
activities.promptAr: صف ثلاثة أفعال ماضية منتظمة من يوم قريب.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.en: I went to the market, bought some fruit and met my old teacher. We had a great time talking.

activities.prompt: Who did the writer meet?
activities.sourceText: I went to the market, bought some fruit and met my old teacher. We had a great time talking.

activities.prompt: Match the key language to its Arabic meaning.
Complete the sentence.
activities.text: We ___ a bus to the centre.

activities.prompt: What did Sara do before coming home?
activities.sourceText: Sara saw a new film, ate dinner with friends and came home at eleven.

activities.prompt: Use three common irregular past verbs to describe a real or fictional outing.
activities.promptAr: استخدم ثلاثة أفعال ماضية شاذة شائعة لوصف نزهة حقيقية أو خيالية.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.en: A: How was the concert? B: Great. A: Who did you go with? B: My sister. We didn't stay for the last song.
dialogue.ar: أ: كيف كانت الحفلة؟ ب: رائعة. أ: مع من ذهبت؟ ب: أختي. لم نبق للأغنية الأخيرة.

activities.prompt: Did they hear the last song?
activities.audioTranscript: A: How was the concert? B: Great. A: Who did you go with? B: My sister. We didn't stay for the last song.

activities.prompt: Match the key language to its Arabic meaning.
Complete the sentence.
activities.text: Where did you ___ last summer?

activities.prompt: How did B avoid arriving late?
activities.audioTranscript: A: What happened yesterday? B: I missed the bus. A: Did you arrive late? B: No, I took a taxi.

activities.prompt: Ask a partner three connected questions about a past experience.
activities.promptAr: اسأل شريكاً ثلاثة أسئلة مترابطة عن تجربة سابقة.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.en: First, we took the wrong road. After that, the car stopped. Finally, a farmer showed us the way.

activities.prompt: Who helped in the end?
activities.sourceText: First, we took the wrong road. After that, the car stopped. Finally, a farmer showed us the way.

activities.prompt: Match the key language to its Arabic meaning.
Put the language in the best order.
What happened immediately after Nabil lost the key?
activities.promptAr: ماذا حدث مباشرة بعد أن أضاع نبيل المفتاح؟
activities.sourceText: Nabil lost his key. Then he called his brother. His brother brought a spare key, and finally Nabil entered the flat.

activities.prompt: Read a four-event timeline and relay the events in the correct order.
activities.promptAr: اقرأ خطاً زمنياً من أربعة أحداث وانقلها بالترتيب الصحيح.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator

activities.prompt: Why did the group call the police?
activities.sourceText: Last Saturday, we went to the lake. Suddenly, we saw a small boat with no one in it. We called the police. In the end, they found the owner safely on the other side.

activities.text: In the end, everyone ___ safe.

activities.prompt: Why did Mona still catch the train?
activities.sourceText: Mona arrived at the station late, but the train was delayed. She bought coffee and finally got on the train at nine.

activities.prompt: Write a short past narrative with a beginning, ordered events and an ending.
activities.promptAr: اكتب سرداً قصيراً في الماضي له بداية وأحداث مرتبة ونهاية.

lessons.title: Mission: A Memorable Day
lessons.scenario: Tell a friend about a memorable day, answer questions, order its events and send a written version.

activities.prompt: Why did the delay become positive?
activities.sourceText: On Friday, Hana missed her train. She waited for the next one, met an old friend on the platform and travelled with her. The delay became the best part of the day.

activities.prompt: Where did the speakers go when it rained?
activities.promptAr: إلى أين ذهب المتحدثون عندما أمطرت؟
activities.audioTranscript: First we visited the market. Then we ate by the river. Suddenly it rained, so we ran into a small café.

activities.prompt: Tell a past experience and respond to at least three follow-up questions.
activities.promptAr: احك تجربة سابقة وأجب عن ثلاثة أسئلة متابعة على الأقل.

activities.prompt: Give a connected one-to-two-minute account of a memorable day.
activities.promptAr: قدّم رواية مترابطة من دقيقة إلى دقيقتين عن يوم لا يُنسى.

activities.prompt: Relay the main events from a provided timeline in the correct order.
activities.promptAr: انقل الأحداث الرئيسية من خط زمني معروض بالترتيب الصحيح.

activities.prompt: Write the memorable day as a connected story with past forms and sequence linkers.
activities.promptAr: اكتب اليوم الذي لا يُنسى كقصة مترابطة مستخدماً صيغ الماضي وروابط التسلسل.

dialogue.speaker: Hanan
dialogue.en: You are collecting Doctor Salwa at the airport. Do you know her?
dialogue.ar: ستستقبل الدكتورة سلوى في المطار. هل تعرفها؟

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: No, never. What does she look like?
dialogue.ar: لا، لم أرها قط. كيف تبدو؟

dialogue.speaker: Hanan
dialogue.en: She is short, with curly grey hair, and she wears glasses.
dialogue.ar: قصيرة القامة، شعرها رمادي مجعد، وترتدي نظارة.

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: Half the airport wears glasses. Tell me about her appearance.
dialogue.ar: نصف من في المطار يرتدون نظارات. حدّثيني أكثر عن مظهرها.

dialogue.speaker: Hanan
dialogue.en: She looks similar to her sister Rasha, and her suitcase is red.
dialogue.ar: تشبه أختها رشا، وحقيبتها حمراء.

dialogue.speaker: Yousef
dialogue.en: Rasha! Now I will recognise her.
dialogue.ar: رشا! الآن سأتعرّف عليها.

activities.prompt: Why does Yousef need the description?
options: So he can find Doctor Salwa at the airport
So he can book her a taxi home
So he can send her photo to Rasha
activities.answer: So he can find Doctor Salwa at the airport
activities.audioTranscript: You are collecting Doctor Salwa at the airport. Do you know her? No, never. What does she look like? She is short, with curly grey hair, and she wears glasses. Half the airport wears glasses. Tell me about her appearance. She looks similar to her sister Rasha, and her suitcase is red. Rasha! Now I will recognise her.

activities.prompt: Looks, not character. Choose the missing word.
activities.promptAr: المظهر لا الطبع. اختر الكلمة الناقصة.
activities.text: What ___ the new teacher look like?

activities.prompt: Match each traveller to the detail that will help the driver find them.
activities.promptAr: طابق كل مسافر بالتفصيل الذي يساعد السائق على إيجاده.
pairs: Doctor Salwa looks similar to her sister,
so Yousef already knows her face.
Mister Adel has a short grey beard,
and he is wearing a blue jacket.
but her suitcase is bright red.

activities.prompt: Listen to the driver's voice message. How will the traveller know it is Yousef?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى رسالة السائق الصوتية. كيف ستعرف المسافرة أنه يوسف؟
options: He is holding a card with her name on it
He is wearing a bright red jacket
He will call her before the plane lands
activities.answer: He is holding a card with her name on it
activities.audioTranscript: This is Yousef at the arrivals gate. I am holding a card with your name on it. I am tall, and I have a short black beard and a grey cap. My English is not good, but my sister wrote this message. Call me when you land.

activities.prompt: A driver is meeting your friend at the airport tomorrow and has never seen her. Describe her out loud: her height, her hair, and one detail he will find quickly.
activities.promptAr: سيستقبل سائقٌ صديقتَك في المطار غداً، وهو لم يرها من قبل. صِفها بصوت عالٍ: طولها، وشعرها، وتفصيلاً واحداً يلاحظه بسرعة.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: You worked with Nabil last year. What is he like?
dialogue.ar: عملتِ مع نبيل العام الماضي. كيف هي شخصيته؟

dialogue.speaker: Dima
dialogue.en: Very patient. He never shouts, even on a bad day.
dialogue.ar: صبور جداً. لا يرفع صوته أبداً، حتى في يوم سيّئ.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: Is he outgoing? Our office eats lunch together.
dialogue.ar: وهل هو اجتماعي؟ نحن في المكتب نتغدّى معاً.

dialogue.speaker: Dima
dialogue.en: A little shy at first, but he is easy to talk to.
dialogue.ar: خجول قليلاً في البداية، لكن الحديث معه سهل.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.en: And is he reliable? I need someone for Saturdays.
dialogue.ar: وهل هو موثوق؟ أحتاج إلى شخص لأيام السبت.

dialogue.speaker: Dima
dialogue.en: Completely. He is also generous, and he always brings coffee.
dialogue.ar: تماماً. وهو كريم أيضاً، ويُحضر القهوة دائماً.

activities.prompt: What is Karim trying to find out?
options: What sort of person Nabil is
activities.answer: What sort of person Nabil is
activities.audioTranscript: You worked with Nabil last year. What is he like? Very patient. He never shouts, even on a bad day. Is he outgoing? Our office eats lunch together. A little shy at first, but he is easy to talk to. And is he reliable? I need someone for Saturdays. Completely. He is also generous, and he always brings coffee.

activities.prompt: Character, not looks. Choose the missing word.
activities.promptAr: الطبع لا المظهر. اختر الكلمة الناقصة.
activities.text: What ___ your new flatmate like? She is quiet and very generous.

activities.prompt: Read the message about a new flatmate. What is it warning Rana about?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الرسالة عن شريكة السكن الجديدة. مِمَّ تحذّر رنا؟
options: Suha needs quiet late in the evening
Suha never cooks for other people
Suha is shy and hard to talk to
activities.answer: Suha needs quiet late in the evening
activities.sourceText: Hi Rana. About the room: my flatmate Suha is quiet in the morning, and she cooks for everyone on Fridays. She is not shy at all once she knows you, and she is generous with her things. She does not like loud music after ten.

activities.prompt: Listen to the reference for Fadi. What does the speaker warn you about?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى التزكية الخاصة بفادي. ممَّ يحذّرك المتحدث؟
options: He will be quiet with new people
He is often late in the morning
He does not like helping anyone
activities.answer: He will be quiet with new people
activities.audioTranscript: You asked about Fadi. He is a very patient man, and he is reliable too. He was never late in three years. He is not outgoing, so he will not talk much at the party, but he is generous with his time and he listens.

activities.prompt: Answer your friend. Say what Hala is like, give two qualities with an example for each, then ask your friend one question about her new office.
activities.promptAr: أجب صديقتك. قل كيف هي شخصية هالة، واذكر صفتين مع مثال لكل صفة، ثم اسألها سؤالاً واحداً عن مكتبها الجديد.
partnerTurns: So you know Hala well. I am sharing an office with her from Sunday. What is she like?
That is good to hear. And is she easy to talk to? I am a bit shy myself.
Thank you. Tell me one more thing about her, and then ask me anything you want.

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: I have to present on Thursday. Who should I ask for help?
dialogue.ar: عليّ تقديم عرض يوم الخميس. مَن أطلب منه المساعدة؟

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.en: Maha or Ziad. Maha is calmer, and she explains things slowly.
dialogue.ar: مها أو زياد. مها أهدأ، وتشرح الأمور ببطء.

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: And Ziad? He is more confident than both of us.
dialogue.ar: وزياد؟ هو أكثر ثقة منا نحن الاثنين.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.en: He is, but he is busier this week than Maha.
dialogue.ar: صحيح، لكنه أكثر انشغالاً من مها هذا الأسبوع.

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: Then Maha. She is also more organised, so she will answer.
dialogue.ar: إذاً مها. وهي أكثر تنظيماً أيضاً، لذا سترد عليّ.

activities.prompt: What are Ruba and Samer deciding?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي تقرره ربى مع سامر؟
options: Who Ruba should ask to help her practise
Which day Ruba will give her presentation
Who is the best speaker in the office
activities.answer: Who Ruba should ask to help her practise
activities.audioTranscript: I have to present on Thursday. Who should I ask for help? Maha or Ziad. Maha is calmer, and she explains things slowly. And Ziad? He is more confident than both of us. He is, but he is busier this week than Maha. Then Maha. She is also more organised, so she will answer.

activities.prompt: A short adjective or a long one? Choose the correct comparative.
activities.promptAr: صفة قصيرة أم طويلة؟ اختر صيغة المقارنة الصحيحة.
activities.text: Maha explains slowly, so she is ___ than Ziad in a long meeting.

activities.prompt: Read the note on the office door. Who should you ask first about a slow laptop?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الملاحظة على باب المكتب. مَن تسأل أولاً عن حاسوب بطيء؟
options: Either of them, because they work together
activities.sourceText: Note on the office door: if your laptop stops working, ask Rami first. He is slower than Sawsan, but he is more helpful with beginners and he never makes you feel silly. Sawsan is quicker, so ask her when the problem is urgent.

activities.prompt: Listen. Why does the speaker choose Basma to feed the cat?
activities.promptAr: استمع. لماذا تختار المتحدثة بسمة لإطعام القطة؟
options: She lives nearer and is more careful
She is the only one who is free
activities.answer: She lives nearer and is more careful
activities.audioTranscript: I need someone to feed the cat next weekend. Huda is friendlier than Basma, but she travels a lot. Basma is quieter and lives closer to us, and she is more careful with keys. So I will ask Basma this time, and Huda in August.

activities.prompt: Think of two people you could ask for help with a difficult form. Compare them using at least two comparative forms, then say which one you will ask and why.
activities.promptAr: فكّر في شخصين يمكنك أن تطلب منهما المساعدة في استمارة صعبة. قارن بينهما بصيغتَي مقارنة على الأقل، ثم قل مَن ستسأل ولماذا.

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: Three roles, three people. Who takes the welcome desk?
dialogue.ar: ثلاثة أدوار وثلاثة أشخاص. مَن يتولّى مكتب الاستقبال؟

dialogue.speaker: Suad
dialogue.en: Nawal. She has the most experience with visitors.
dialogue.ar: نوال. لديها أكبر خبرة مع الزوّار.

dialogue.speaker: Hani
dialogue.en: And the posters? Karim is the most creative person here.
dialogue.ar: وماذا عن الملصقات؟ كريم أكثرنا إبداعاً هنا.

dialogue.speaker: Suad
dialogue.en: Agreed. That leaves the children's games.
dialogue.ar: متفقة. يبقى إذاً ألعاب الأطفال.

dialogue.speaker: Faris
dialogue.en: Rania, then. She is the most active of all of us.
dialogue.ar: رانية إذاً. هي الأنشط بيننا جميعاً.

dialogue.speaker: Hani
dialogue.en: Three different roles, three best choices. Nobody does everything.
dialogue.ar: ثلاثة أدوار مختلفة وثلاثة خيارات أفضل. لا أحد يقوم بكل شيء.

activities.prompt: How are the three of them dividing the work?
options: Each person takes the job that suits them best
One person will do all three jobs
activities.answer: Each person takes the job that suits them best
activities.audioTranscript: Three roles, three people. Who takes the welcome desk? Nawal. She has the most experience with visitors. And the posters? Karim is the most creative person here. Agreed. That leaves the children's games. Rania, then. She is the most active of all of us. Three different roles, three best choices. Nobody does everything.

activities.prompt: One person above everyone else. Choose the correct form.
activities.promptAr: شخص واحد يتفوق على الجميع. اختر الصيغة الصحيحة.
activities.text: Of the four volunteers, Rania is ___ active.

activities.prompt: Listen to the manager give out the jobs. Why does Lubna write the report?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى المديرة وهي توزّع المهام. لماذا تكتب لبنى التقرير؟
options: She is the most careful with numbers
She is the friendliest of them
activities.answer: She is the most careful with numbers
activities.audioTranscript: Listen, everybody. Ahmad will drive the van, because he knows the city best. Sana will meet the families at the door; she is the friendliest of us. And Lubna will write the report, because she is the most careful with numbers. Nobody is the best at everything.

activities.prompt: Read the staff notice. Why does Yasmin lead the group?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان الموظفين. لماذا تقود ياسمين المجموعة؟
options: She is the strongest of them
She wrote the list of names
activities.sourceText: Saturday clean-up: the roles are now fixed. Yasmin leads the group, because she has the most experience. Omar takes the tools; he is the strongest of us. Dalia writes the list of names. Please do not swap roles on the day.

activities.prompt: Two colleagues are waiting for their jobs at a school open day: one is very organised, the other is very good with children. Write a short note to the head teacher. Give each of them one role, and say why each one is the best choice for it.
activities.promptAr: زميلان ينتظران مهمتيهما في يوم مفتوح بالمدرسة: أحدهما منظّم جداً، والآخر يجيد التعامل مع الأطفال. اكتب ملاحظة قصيرة إلى مدير المدرسة. امنح كل واحد منهما دوراً، وبيّن لماذا هو الخيار الأفضل له.

dialogue.speaker: Iman
dialogue.en: Our street needs a person who can speak to the council.
dialogue.ar: شارعنا يحتاج إلى شخص يستطيع مخاطبة البلدية.

dialogue.speaker: Bashir
dialogue.en: Ask Mister Jalal. He is the neighbour who fixed the lights.
dialogue.ar: اسألي الأستاذ جلال. هو الجار الذي أصلح الإنارة.

dialogue.speaker: Iman
dialogue.en: Does he get on well with the office there?
dialogue.ar: وهل ينسجم مع الموظفين هناك؟

dialogue.speaker: Bashir
dialogue.en: Very well. My colleague Sara works there, and they trust him.
dialogue.ar: ينسجم تماماً. زميلتي سارة تعمل هناك، وهم يثقون به.

dialogue.speaker: Iman
dialogue.en: Good. A quiet relationship like that opens more doors than shouting.
dialogue.ar: جيد. علاقة هادئة كهذه تفتح أبواباً أكثر من الصراخ.

activities.prompt: What does the street need?
options: Someone who can talk to the council for them
A new set of street lights
A neighbour who can drive a van
activities.answer: Someone who can talk to the council for them
activities.audioTranscript: Our street needs a person who can speak to the council. Ask Mister Jalal. He is the neighbour who fixed the lights. Does he get on well with the office there? Very well. My colleague Sara works there, and they trust him. Good. A quiet relationship like that opens more doors than shouting.

activities.prompt: Which word introduces the person? Complete the advert.
activities.promptAr: أي كلمة تُدخِل وصف الشخص؟ أكمل الإعلان.
activities.text: We are looking for someone ___ can drive a small van.

activities.prompt: Read the noticeboard advert. Who is it looking for?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان لوحة الحي. عمَّن يبحث؟
options: Someone who can explain English letters to older people
Someone who can teach an English class on Sundays
Someone who can drive older neighbours to the post office
activities.answer: Someone who can explain English letters to older people
activities.sourceText: Noticeboard, Al-Hadba Street. Wanted: a person who can read letters in English for older neighbours, one hour on Sunday mornings. You do not need any training. You do need patience, and a neighbour who will sit with you the first time.

activities.prompt: Listen to the three neighbours. Who would you ask about a letter you cannot read?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى وصف الجيران الثلاثة. مَن تسأل بشأن رسالة لا تستطيع قراءتها؟
activities.audioTranscript: Three people help on our street. Umm Salim is the woman who cooks when a family has a new baby. Abu Nasser is a neighbour who repairs bicycles for free. And Widad is a colleague of mine who writes letters for people who cannot read.

activities.prompt: Answer your neighbour. Suggest a person who could help her mother, describe that person with someone who, and ask your neighbour one question about what her mother needs.
activities.promptAr: أجب جارتك. اقترح شخصاً يستطيع مساعدة والدتها، وصِفه بعبارة someone who، ثم اسألها سؤالاً واحداً عمّا تحتاجه والدتها.
partnerTurns: Good morning. My mother is alone all day now, and I work until six. I do not know who to ask.
That is kind of you. Is she someone my mother will trust? My mother is very shy with new people.
Thank you. Tell me how you know her, and then ask me anything you need to know.

readingText.title: Who I Would Choose
readingText.text: Dear Mrs Zeinab, you asked me about the two new members for the reading team. I would choose Hind and Ayman. Hind is good at planning, and she is the most organised person in our group. Ayman is good with children, and he is patient as well. Hind is quieter than Ayman, but that is useful: he talks to the families and she keeps the lists. Their strengths are different, so they are a suitable pair. Warm regards, Nour.
readingText.textAr: عزيزتي السيدة زينب، سألتِني عن العضوين الجديدين لفريق القراءة. أختار هند وأيمن. هند تجيد التخطيط، وهي أكثرنا تنظيماً في المجموعة. وأيمن يحسن التعامل مع الأطفال، وهو صبور أيضاً. هند أهدأ من أيمن، لكن ذلك مفيد: هو يتحدث إلى العائلات وهي تتولّى القوائم. نقاط قوتهما مختلفة، لذا فهما ثنائي مناسب. مع خالص التحية، نور.

activities.prompt: Read Nour's note once. What is she telling Mrs Zeinab?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ ملاحظة نور مرة واحدة. ماذا تخبر به السيدة زينب؟
options: Why these two people work well together
That the team already has too many members
That she cannot join the team herself
activities.answer: Why these two people work well together

activities.prompt: Listen to Mrs Zeinab's reply. What is her worry about Ayman?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى ردّ السيدة زينب. ما الذي يقلقها بشأن أيمن؟
options: He may not have the time every week
He is not good enough with children
He is less organised than Hind
activities.answer: He may not have the time every week
activities.audioTranscript: It is Zeinab. Thank you for the note. I agree about Hind, and she is the most organised of all of us. I am not sure about Ayman, though. He is kind, but he is also the busiest man in the building. Can he really come every Saturday?

activities.prompt: Before you write, say your own recommendation out loud, the way Nour wrote hers. Name two people, say what each one is good at, and add one quality they share using too or also.
activities.promptAr: قبل أن تكتب، قل توصيتك بصوت عالٍ كما كتبت نور توصيتها. سمِّ شخصين، واذكر ما يجيده كل منهما، وأضف صفة مشتركة بينهما مستخدماً too أو also.

activities.prompt: Mrs Zeinab sent you this message and Ayman never saw it. Tell him when and where the team meets, the two kinds of person it needs, and the one condition.
activities.promptAr: أرسلت لكَ السيدة زينب هذه الرسالة، ولم يرَها أيمن. أخبره متى يجتمع الفريق وأين، وأي نوعين من الأشخاص يحتاج، والشرط الوحيد.
activities.sourceCard: Message from Mrs Zeinab: the reading team meets on Saturdays from nine to eleven, in the room behind the mosque. We need one person who is good with children and one who can keep the lists. No experience is needed, but please come for both hours.

activities.prompt: Write your own note recommending two people for a small team. Say what each one is good at, add one quality they share with too or also, and explain with and, but and because why the two of them fit together.
activities.promptAr: اكتب ملاحظتك الخاصة توصي فيها بشخصين لفريق صغير. اذكر ما يجيده كل منهما، وأضف صفة مشتركة بينهما بـ too أو also، واشرح بـ and وbut وbecause لماذا يتكاملان معاً.

lessons.title: Mission: Choose the Best Person for a Team
lessons.scenario: A community project needs two new members. Understand the profiles, discuss the candidates, make a choice and explain it.

activities.prompt: Read the three candidate notes. Who is the best choice for the morning shift, and why?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ ملاحظات المرشحين الثلاثة. مَن الخيار الأفضل لنوبة الصباح ولماذا؟
options: Lubna, because she is free all day
Hanaa, because she has the most experience
Mazen, because he knows every street
activities.answer: Lubna, because she is free all day
activities.sourceText: Candidates for the community kitchen. Hanaa: five years in a school canteen, very organised, cannot come before four. Mazen: no experience with food, but he drives a van and knows every street. Lubna: calm and quick, free all day, new to the city.

activities.prompt: Listen to the kitchen manager. What does she say about the driver?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى مديرة المطبخ. ماذا تقول عن السائق؟
options: He does not have to cook at all
He must start work at seven
activities.answer: He does not have to cook at all
activities.audioTranscript: This is Umm Rami from the kitchen. Two things. The morning cook must start at seven, so anybody who works until four is no good for us. And the driver does not need to cook at all; he only needs a clean van and a good map.

activities.prompt: Discuss the three candidates with the project leader. Compare at least two of them, disagree politely once, and agree on two names.
activities.promptAr: ناقش المرشحين الثلاثة مع مسؤولة المشروع. قارن بين اثنين منهم على الأقل، واعترض بلطف مرة واحدة، واتفقا على اسمين.
partnerTurns: So, we have three names and two places. I like Hanaa; nobody here has more experience than her.
That is true, but she cannot start before four, and the cooking starts at seven. Who else, then?
Good. Tell me your two names, and I will write them on the list.

activities.prompt: Explain your choice to the whole group in one minute. Describe the two people you chose, compare them with each other, and say which part of the work each one is best at.
activities.promptAr: اشرح اختيارك أمام المجموعة كلها في دقيقة واحدة. صف الشخصين اللذين اخترتهما، وقارن بينهما، وقل أي جزء من العمل يجيده كل واحد منهما أكثر.

activities.prompt: The two people you chose do not read English. Tell them when the training is, what to bring, what the centre pays for, and what to do if they cannot come.
activities.promptAr: الشخصان اللذان اخترتهما لا يقرآن الإنجليزية. أخبرهما متى التدريب، وماذا يُحضران، وما الذي يدفع المركز ثمنه، وماذا يفعلان إن تعذّر حضورهما.
activities.sourceCard: Message from the community centre: both new volunteers must come to a short training on Thursday evening, from six to seven. Bring an identity card. The centre pays for the bus, but not for food. If you cannot come on Thursday, tell us before Tuesday.

activities.prompt: Write your recommendation to the community centre. Name the two people you chose, give each one a job, compare them with the candidate you did not choose, and explain your reasons with and, but and because.
activities.promptAr: اكتب توصيتك إلى المركز المجتمعي. سمِّ الشخصين اللذين اخترتهما، وامنح كلاً منهما مهمة، وقارنهما بالمرشح الذي لم تختره، واشرح أسبابك بـ and وbut وbecause.

dialogue.speaker: Sameer
dialogue.en: How is the new flat, Ruba?
dialogue.ar: كيف هي الشقة الجديدة يا ربى؟

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: Much better. In the old building there wasn't a lift, and we were on the fourth floor.
dialogue.ar: أفضل بكثير. في البناية القديمة لم يكن هناك مصعد، وكنّا في الطابق الرابع.

dialogue.speaker: Sameer
dialogue.en: Was there a balcony?
dialogue.ar: وهل كانت فيها شرفة؟

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: No, there wasn't. And the heating was always broken in winter.
dialogue.ar: لا، لم تكن. وكانت التدفئة معطّلة دائماً في الشتاء.

dialogue.speaker: Sameer
dialogue.en: So that is why you moved.
dialogue.ar: إذن لهذا السبب انتقلتِ.

dialogue.speaker: Ruba
dialogue.en: Yes. There used to be a garden, though, and I miss it.
dialogue.ar: نعم. لكن كانت هناك حديقة فيما مضى، وأنا أفتقدها.

activities.prompt: What is Ruba comparing?
options: Her old building and her new flat
Two gardens on the same street
Two jobs in the same city
activities.answer: Her old building and her new flat
activities.audioTranscript: How is the new flat, Ruba? Much better. In the old building there wasn't a lift, and we were on the fourth floor. Was there a balcony? No, there wasn't. And the heating was always broken in winter. So that is why you moved. Yes. There used to be a garden, though, and I miss it.

activities.prompt: The old house had more than one bedroom. Choose the form that says so.
activities.promptAr: كان في المنزل القديم أكثر من غرفة نوم واحدة. اختر الصيغة التي تعبّر عن ذلك.
activities.text: There ___ three bedrooms in the old house, but only one bathroom.

activities.prompt: Match each sentence about an old home with the part that finishes it.
activities.promptAr: طابق كل جملة عن منزل قديم بالجزء الذي يكملها.
pairs: so we carried the shopping upstairs.
and my mother grew flowers on both.
so the rooms were cold in January.

activities.prompt: How did the family keep warm in winter?
activities.promptAr: كيف كانت العائلة تتدفأ في الشتاء؟
options: They all sat in the kitchen
activities.answer: They all sat in the kitchen
activities.audioTranscript: Before we moved to Basra, we lived in a small house in Duhok. There were two rooms and a long balcony at the back. There was no heating, so in winter we all sat in the kitchen next to the stove.

activities.prompt: Describe a home you lived in before. Say what there was, what there wasn't, and one thing you miss about it.
activities.promptAr: صف منزلاً سكنتَ فيه سابقاً. اذكر ما كان فيه، وما لم يكن فيه، وشيئاً واحداً تفتقده منه.

dialogue.speaker: Kamal
dialogue.en: How is your new neighbourhood, Nour?
dialogue.ar: كيف هو حيّكِ الجديد يا نور؟

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.en: Very convenient. There are a lot of small shops, and the market is close to us.
dialogue.ar: ملائم جداً. توجد متاجر صغيرة كثيرة، والسوق قريب منّا.

dialogue.speaker: Kamal
dialogue.en: Are there many buses?
dialogue.ar: وهل هناك حافلات كثيرة؟

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.en: Not many after nine, but the metro station is within walking distance.
dialogue.ar: ليست كثيرة بعد التاسعة، لكن محطة المترو على بعد مسافة قصيرة سيراً على الأقدام.

dialogue.speaker: Kamal
dialogue.en: And is there much noise at night?
dialogue.ar: وهل هناك ضجيج كثير في الليل؟

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.en: Not much. There is one café nearby, and it closes at eleven.
dialogue.ar: ليس كثيراً. يوجد مقهى واحد قريب، ويُغلق في الحادية عشرة.

activities.prompt: What is Kamal finding out about Nour's area?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي يكتشفه كمال عن منطقة نور؟
options: What is nearby and how busy it is
Which floor her flat is on
activities.answer: What is nearby and how busy it is
activities.audioTranscript: How is your new neighbourhood, Nour? Very convenient. There are a lot of small shops, and the market is close to us. Are there many buses? Not many after nine, but the metro station is within walking distance. And is there much noise at night? Not much. There is one café nearby, and it closes at eleven.

activities.prompt: Traffic is one thing you cannot count. Choose the word that fits it.
activities.promptAr: حركة المرور شيء لا يُعَدّ. اختر الكلمة المناسبة له.
activities.text: Is there ___ traffic on your street in the evening?

activities.prompt: Read the flat listing. What should a person with a car check first?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ إعلان الشقة. ما الذي يجب أن يتحقق منه صاحب السيارة أولاً؟
options: Whether a parking space is free
Whether the flat has two bedrooms
activities.answer: Whether a parking space is free
activities.sourceText: TO LET: two-bedroom flat, Al-Mansour. Third floor, no lift. A lot of natural light. The building has one shared facility, a roof terrace. Not many parking spaces. Bus stop and pharmacy within walking distance. 600,000 IQD monthly.

activities.prompt: What is this area short of?
activities.promptAr: ما الذي تفتقر إليه هذه المنطقة؟
activities.audioTranscript: I chose this neighbourhood because of the facilities. There are a lot of good schools, and there is a big park at the end of the road. There aren't many restaurants, but the supermarket is open until midnight, and that is enough for us.

activities.prompt: Answer Rana's questions about your area, then ask her one question about what she needs.
activities.promptAr: أجب عن أسئلة رنا حول منطقتك، ثم اسألها سؤالاً واحداً عمّا تحتاج إليه.
partnerTurns: Hello! I am looking at a flat in your street. What is the area like?
That sounds good. Is there much noise in the evening?
One more thing: are there many shops within walking distance? Tell me, and then ask me what I need.

dialogue.speaker: Ammar
dialogue.en: You know both areas, Suha. Which one should I choose?
dialogue.ar: أنتِ تعرفين المنطقتين يا سُها. أيّهما أختار؟

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: The riverside is greener, but it is not as cheap as Al-Jisr.
dialogue.ar: منطقة النهر أكثر خضرةً، لكنها ليست رخيصة مثل الجسر.

dialogue.speaker: Ammar
dialogue.en: Is it far from the hospital?
dialogue.ar: وهل هي بعيدة عن المستشفى؟

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: It is further, yes. Al-Jisr is more crowded, though, and less peaceful.
dialogue.ar: نعم، أبعد قليلاً. لكن الجسر أكثر ازدحاماً وأقلّ هدوءاً.

dialogue.speaker: Ammar
dialogue.en: So the riverside is quieter?
dialogue.ar: إذن منطقة النهر أهدأ؟

dialogue.speaker: Suha
dialogue.en: Much quieter. Compared with Al-Jisr, it feels like another city.
dialogue.ar: أهدأ بكثير. بالمقارنة مع الجسر، تبدو وكأنها مدينة أخرى.

activities.prompt: What are Ammar and Suha comparing?
options: Two areas of the same city
Two flats in the same building
Two ways to reach the hospital
activities.answer: Two areas of the same city
activities.audioTranscript: You know both areas, Suha. Which one should I choose? The riverside is greener, but it is not as cheap as Al-Jisr. Is it far from the hospital? It is further, yes. Al-Jisr is more crowded, though, and less peaceful. So the riverside is quieter? Much quieter. Compared with Al-Jisr, it feels like another city.

activities.prompt: The two flats cost exactly the same. Choose the word that says so.
activities.promptAr: الشقتان تكلّفان المبلغ نفسه تماماً. اختر الكلمة التي تعبّر عن ذلك.
activities.text: The riverside flat is ___ expensive as the one on Al-Jisr Street.

activities.prompt: Read the two listings. Which home suits a family that wants space?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الإعلانين. أي منزل يناسب عائلة تريد مساحة؟
activities.sourceText: Al-Jisr Street: a spacious three-bedroom house with a small garden, ten minutes from the market by bus. Riverside: a two-bedroom flat, not as big as the house, but the rooms are brighter and the street is much quieter at night.

activities.prompt: Why did the speaker choose Zayouna?
options: He needs a quiet place to work
There is a market on every corner
activities.answer: He needs a quiet place to work
activities.audioTranscript: I looked at two areas last month. Al-Karrada is livelier, and there is a market on every corner. But it is not as peaceful as Zayouna, and the flats there are smaller. In the end I chose Zayouna, because I work from home.

activities.prompt: Compare two areas you know. Say which one is cheaper, bigger or quieter, use not as ... as once, and say where you would live and why.
activities.promptAr: قارن بين منطقتين تعرفهما. قل أيّهما أرخص أو أوسع أو أهدأ، واستخدم not as ... as مرة واحدة، ثم قل أين تفضّل السكن ولماذا.

lessons.title: Too Small or Big Enough?
lessons.titleAr: صغير جداً أم كبير بما يكفي؟

dialogue.speaker: Fouad
dialogue.en: This is the living room. Is it bright enough for you?
dialogue.ar: هذه غرفة المعيشة. هل هي مضيئة بما يكفي بالنسبة لكِ؟

dialogue.speaker: Maryam
dialogue.en: Yes, but the kitchen is too small for three children.
dialogue.ar: نعم، لكن المطبخ صغير أكثر من اللازم لثلاثة أطفال.

dialogue.speaker: Fouad
dialogue.en: There is a storage space next to it.
dialogue.ar: توجد مساحة تخزين بجانبه.

dialogue.speaker: Maryam
dialogue.en: Good. Is the street noisy?
dialogue.ar: جيد. وهل الشارع صاخب؟

dialogue.speaker: Fouad
dialogue.en: Not in the day. At night the café below is too loud.
dialogue.ar: ليس في النهار. أما في الليل فالمقهى الذي في الأسفل صاخب أكثر من اللازم.

dialogue.speaker: Maryam
dialogue.en: Then the bedrooms are not quiet enough for us.
dialogue.ar: إذن غرف النوم ليست هادئة بما يكفي لنا.

activities.prompt: What is Maryam deciding?
options: Whether the flat suits her family
activities.answer: Whether the flat suits her family
activities.audioTranscript: This is the living room. Is it bright enough for you? Yes, but the kitchen is too small for three children. There is a storage space next to it. Good. Is the street noisy? Not in the day. At night the café below is too loud. Then the bedrooms are not quiet enough for us.

activities.prompt: The room is a problem, not a good size. Choose the word that shows it.
activities.promptAr: الغرفة مشكلة، لا حجماً مناسباً. اختر الكلمة التي تُظهر ذلك.
activities.text: The second bedroom is ___ narrow for two beds.

activities.prompt: Listen to the voice message. Why is the speaker still unsure?
activities.promptAr: استمع إلى الرسالة الصوتية. لماذا ما زالت المتحدثة مترددة؟
options: Her mother cannot climb five floors
There is no storage at all
activities.answer: Her mother cannot climb five floors
activities.audioTranscript: I saw the flat on Palm Street this morning. The living room is bright enough and there is plenty of storage. But the building has no lift, and the fifth floor is too high for my mother. I am still thinking about it.

activities.prompt: Read the notice in the entrance hall. What must residents not do this week?
activities.promptAr: اقرأ الإعلان المعلّق في مدخل البناية. ما الذي يُمنع على السكان فعله هذا الأسبوع؟
activities.sourceText: NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS. The lift will be switched off from Monday to Thursday for repairs. The stairs are wide enough for two people, but please do not leave bags on them. The basement storage will stay open. Sorry for the trouble. The Building Office.

activities.prompt: You saw a flat yesterday with the friend who is moving with you. Write her a message. Say one thing that is good enough, two things that are too small, too noisy or too far, and what you want to do next.
activities.promptAr: شاهدتَ شقة أمس مع صديقتك التي ستنتقل معك. اكتب لها رسالة. اذكر شيئاً واحداً جيداً بما يكفي، وشيئين أصغر أو أصخب أو أبعد من اللازم، وما الذي تريد فعله بعد ذلك.

dialogue.speaker: Ilham

readingText.title: Which Home for Samar?
readingText.text: Samar, I looked at both options yesterday. The Karrada flat is furnished and the rent is 550 a month, with bills included. It is not as quiet as the other one, but it is only ten minutes from your office. The Zayouna flat is cheaper and more spacious, and the street is peaceful. However, it is unfurnished, the deposit is two months, and there is no bus after nine. For you, I recommend Karrada. The rent is higher, but you will not need a car.
readingText.textAr: سمر، نظرتُ إلى الخيارين أمس. شقة الكرادة مفروشة، وإيجارها 550 في الشهر مع الفواتير. هي ليست هادئة مثل الشقة الأخرى، لكنها على بعد عشر دقائق فقط من مكتبكِ. شقة زيونة أرخص وأوسع، والشارع فيها هادئ. لكنها غير مفروشة، والتأمين إيجار شهرين، ولا توجد حافلة بعد التاسعة. بالنسبة لكِ، أنصحكِ بالكرادة: الإيجار أعلى، لكنكِ لن تحتاجي إلى سيارة.

finalMission.title: Host a Visitor
finalMission.sourcePolicy: All names, schedules, notices, service problems and visitor details are fictional and unseen in earlier lessons.
finalMission.scenario: A friend is visiting for two days. Build the plan from new messages and notices, explain the neighbourhood, handle food, health and technology problems, then write a follow-up.

activities.sourceText: Visitor message: I arrive Friday at 17:40. I prefer a quiet room, cannot eat nuts, and need reliable Wi-Fi for a meeting Saturday at 09:00. I leave Sunday at 16:15.
activities.prompt: Which three needs affect the plan?
activities.promptAr: ما الاحتياجات الثلاثة التي تؤثر في الخطة؟
options: Quiet room, nut-free food, reliable Wi-Fi
Late breakfast, a car, live music
A large party, seafood, no internet
activities.answer: Quiet room, nut-free food, reliable Wi-Fi

activities.sourceText: Neighbourhood notice: The west bus stop is closed this weekend. Use the library stop instead. The pharmacy closes at 18:00 on Saturday; the urgent-care centre is open until 22:00.
activities.prompt: Where should the visitor take the bus?
activities.promptAr: من أين ينبغي للزائر ركوب الحافلة؟

activities.prompt: What is the revised arrival time?

activities.prompt: Welcome the visitor, confirm arrival and departure details, and ask at least three connected questions about needs or preferences.
activities.promptAr: رحّب بالزائر وأكد تفاصيل الوصول والمغادرة واسأل ثلاثة أسئلة مترابطة على الأقل عن الاحتياجات أو التفضيلات.

activities.prompt: Role-play one problem: the restaurant order is unsafe, the Wi-Fi fails before the meeting, or the visitor feels unwell. Clarify the problem and agree on a practical solution using the supplied facts.
activities.promptAr: مثّل مشكلة واحدة: الطلب غير آمن أو تعطل الواي فاي قبل الاجتماع أو شعر الزائر بالتعب. وضّح المشكلة واتفق على حل عملي مستخدماً الحقائق المقدمة.

activities.prompt: Present the two-day itinerary in a clear order. Include transport, two activities, food arrangements and one Plan B.
activities.promptAr: قدّم برنامج اليومين بترتيب واضح. ضمّن النقل ونشاطين وترتيبات الطعام وخطة بديلة واحدة.

activities.prompt: Describe the neighbourhood to the visitor, comparing two areas and explaining the location of four useful services.
activities.promptAr: صف الحي للزائر وقارن منطقتين واشرح موقع أربع خدمات مفيدة.

activities.prompt: Relay the revised train time, unchanged platform and replacement bus stop from the notices. Preserve all numbers exactly.
activities.promptAr: انقل وقت القطار المعدل ورقم الرصيف غير المتغير ومحطة الحافلة البديلة من الإشعارات. حافظ على جميع الأرقام بدقة.

activities.prompt: Relay the visitor's food need and the café's ordering condition to another person without adding medical or dietary claims.
activities.promptAr: انقل حاجة الزائر الغذائية وشرط الطلب في المقهى إلى شخص آخر من دون إضافة ادعاءات طبية أو غذائية.

activities.prompt: Write the visitor the final practical plan: arrival, transport change, accommodation, activities, food arrangement and what to do if Wi-Fi fails.
activities.promptAr: اكتب للزائر الخطة العملية النهائية: الوصول وتغيير النقل والإقامة والأنشطة وترتيب الطعام وما ينبغي فعله إذا تعطل الواي فاي.

activities.prompt: After the visit, write a friendly follow-up message. Mention two past events, one opinion, thanks and a future invitation.
activities.promptAr: بعد الزيارة اكتب رسالة متابعة ودودة. اذكر حدثين ماضيين ورأياً واحداً وشكراً ودعوة مستقبلية.
